# CivicPulse — Implementation Tasks

## Source

- ColorLib Politics: https://colorlib.com/wp/template/politics/
- Preview: https://preview.colorlib.com/theme/politics/
- New name: civicpulse

## Design Tokens

- Primary: #3898f8 (blue)
- Light bg: #f9f9ff
- Dark/footer: #04091e
- Headings: #222222
- Body: #777777
- Font: Poppins
- Button: pill (25px radius)

## Sections

1. TopBar — dark social/contact bar
2. Navbar — sticky white, logo + nav links
3. Hero — bg image, overlay, CTA
4. Countdown — election countdown timer
5. Services — 3 service cards
6. About — split image + text + features
7. Gallery — 4-image masonry grid
8. Counter — dark overlay, 4 circular stats
9. Feedback — accordion + video
10. Brands — grayscale logo strip
11. Blog — 4 blog cards
12. Footer — dark, newsletter, Component Dock link

## Notes

- Uses picsum.photos for placeholder images
- lucide-react for generic icons, inline SVG for social brands
- No ColorLib references in app code
- Footer links https://www.componentdock.com/
